common_precollapse_input: On sector k, X=A d_k+B d_(k+1), with 0<A,B<1 on the open source fiber.
coherent_coupled_completion_axiom: All noninteger active channel magnitudes use one shared branch bit: LOWER means every active magnitude collapses toward the signed origin; UPPER means every active magnitude collapses away from the signed origin. Per-channel mixed branch bits are excluded from the coherent collapse-direction class but retained as a broader-policy control.

intermediate_axis_corners.classification: legal componentwise integer completions but not coherent all-lower/all-upper outcomes
intermediate_axis_corners.importance: If arbitrary independent channel branches are admitted, direct axis policies can close a one-step cycle without raw DOWN; this is the exact scope boundary for the later necessity theorem.

noncircularity: The branch definitions use only the common componentwise adjacent-integer box, a single shared branch bit, and the target primitive budget order. No closure result or desired endpoint is read by UP or DOWN.
